design: Approved LLA/Hashbrown system: light base for four practical guidance cards, dark for three technical posts, amber for two announcements. Hashbrown primary, LLA studio signature; Bend patch on author photo only.

assets.altText: “Local models. Real limits.” November 2026 web LLM update, with Brian Love’s original airport photograph in a rounded frame and the LiveLoveApp Bend patch, on Hashbrown amber.

provenance.source: Original IMG_6068.HEIC photograph from photo kit v02; official LiveLoveApp patch and mark; approved amber concept
